aarch64-linux-android.reason: the release ships its Linux compiler stamped src:85ccd72f8e53 (built from the tag's exported tree, which has no .git) and this runtime stamped git:381045a8735f; Perry refuses the pair. build-cross-runtime.mjs builds the runtime from the same tag, exported the same way, which takes the compiler's stamp.
aarch64-linux-android.trust: The build id is the only trust anchor: it is a hash of the sources the compiler was built from, and Perry refuses a runtime that does not carry it. The archives are not pinned by checksum because a Rust build is not reproducible bit for bit across machines and paths.
